name: Omni Fort Lauderdale Hotel
insider_take: This sleek downtown tower puts you at the epicenter of Fort Lauderdale's cultural renaissance, where luxury meets the laid-back coastal vibe of the Venice of America.
whats_special: The Omni Fort Lauderdale stands as the city's tallest building, offering unparalleled views of the New River and Atlantic Ocean. Located in the heart of the arts and entertainment district, you're steps from the Broward Center for the Performing Arts and the historic Riverwalk. The hotel's rooftop pool deck provides stunning 360-degree views, while the building's LEED Gold certification showcases its commitment to sustainability.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room on floors 15+ for breathtaking sunrise views over the Intracoastal Waterway and easy access to water taxi stops that connect you to Las Olas Boulevard and the beach.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary water taxi from the hotel's dock to explore Las Olas Boulevard's boutiques and cafes, or cruise to the beach. The hotel sits directly on the Riverwalk Linear Park, perfect for jogging or cycling along the New River's scenic pathway that connects downtown to the ocean.
pros: Rooftop Pool & Skyline Views — A stunning rooftop pool deck offers sweeping panoramic views of the Fort Lauderdale skyline and waterways, perfect for relaxing in style.
Prime Downtown Location — Ideally situated steps from Las Olas Boulevard, the Broward County Convention Center, and Fort Lauderdale's vibrant dining and entertainment scene.
Upscale Dining & Bar Scene — Multiple on-site dining outlets deliver elevated culinary experiences, from craft cocktails to refined coastal cuisine, without leaving the property.
Modern, Luxuriously Appointed Rooms — Spacious guestrooms feature sleek contemporary design, premium bedding, and floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing impressive city or water views.
Full-Service Spa & Wellness Facilities — A dedicated spa and state-of-the-art fitness center provide guests with comprehensive wellness and rejuvenation options on-site.
cons: Downtown Urban Setting — Guests seeking a beachfront resort experience should note the hotel is located in the downtown core, requiring a short drive or rideshare to reach the beach.
Convention Center Crowds — As an anchor hotel for the Broward County Convention Center, the property can experience higher occupancy and busier public spaces during large events.
